A '''Plug-6 heavy fighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was also used as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] by various [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
